description: Intercom support connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's recent Intercom conversations as `intercom:conversation` items in the local index — the conversation subject/title, state (open/closed/snoozed), priority, the read flag, the source message author + first message body, the linked contact ids, the admin + team assignees, tags, and the created / updated dates. Useful for answering support questions ("what conversations are still open?", "find the thread about the billing bug") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer access-token auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` — an Intercom Access Token; never logged) plus the `Intercom-Version: 2.11` and `Accept: application/json` request headers. The SaaS host (api.intercom.io, US) is fixed — EU/AU regional hosts are a deferred follow-up. Intercom paginates the `/conversations` endpoint with a cursor (`pages.next.starting_after`, per_page=150), returning the `{ type: "conversation.list", conversations, pages, total_count }` envelope. `created_at` / `updated_at` are epoch SECONDS (converted to epoch-ms on index). Contacts / companies / tickets / admins-as-items and write tools are deferred follow-ups; v1 indexes conversations only.
author: Nimbus
